title: Duolingo -- the next chapter in human computation |  Luis von Ahn | TEDxCMU 2011
summary: Luis von Ahn, creator of CAPTCHA and reCAPTCHA, presents Duolingo at TEDxCMU 2011. The idea is to have millions of people translate the web for free while learning a language, an example of human computation.
why: HN people recommend it as a look at how to get people to eagerly do useful collective work, and as the origin of Duolingo.
